summary: This is a downloadable dataset of official USPS ZIP Code boundary polygons for GIS and spatial analysis. It is accessed via a web page that offers an API/SDK and version 1.0 release notes, but lacks a package manager distribution. It is suited for analysts needing authoritative ZIP boundaries, especially when higher‑resolution official data is required. While the documentation is thorough and community interest is high (665 HN points), the tool fails all automated tests and provides no performance benchmarks, limiting its reliability.
